_readme: Rules for setup/tools/temucraft-expansions.py: which expansion each module's new rows come from.
Expansion values: 0-2 are what AoWoW already knows, 3-10 the later expansions, 20 and up our own content.
Each rule matches a module folder and, if given, a SQL file name (fnmatch patterns, first matching rule wins).
expansion: the value for the rows the rule matches; null means the module's rows are left alone (stock reworks).
id_ranges: [[first, last, expansion], ...] wins over expansion for ids in a range (for files with two expansions).
from_loot: true tags an item with the expansion of the rule whose loot drops it (Cataclysm or Mists loot).
maps: map ids that belong to the rule; spawn_maps: true also takes every map its creature/gameobject spawns use
that is not a stock 3.3.5 map. spell_refs: true tags the spells its creatures cast (creature_template_spell,
smart_scripts) when they are newer than 3.3.5 and no rule defines them. override_stock: true tags rows even when the id exists in the stock world database.
Add a new module by adding a rule above the catch-all ones at the end.

stock._readme: Ids AoWoW already knows from stock 3.3.5a: never tagged. Creatures, objects, items and quests are checked against --stock-db or --stock-ids; spells up to spell_max are in the stock Spell.dbc.
